Institutional Investors Are Betting On Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL)
October 10, 2018 - By Lisa Delgado Sentiment for Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL)
Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) institutional sentiment increased to 0.71 in Q2 2018 . Its up 0.02, from 0.69 in 2018Q1. The ratio is more positive, as 754 hedge funds opened new or increased positions, while 1059 cut down and sold stakes in Apple Inc. The hedge funds in our partner’s database now hold: 2.77 billion shares, down from 2.86 billion shares in 2018Q1. Also, the number of hedge funds holding Apple Inc in their top 10 positions increased from 922 to 934 for an increase of 12. Sold All: 57 Reduced: 1002 Increased: 622 New Position: 132.
Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players to consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, and education, enterprise, and government clients worldwide. The company has market cap of $. The firm also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. It has a 20.02 P/E ratio. It offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers.
The stock decreased 2.58% or $5.86 during the last trading session, reaching $221.01. About 24.34M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 37.43% since October 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 21.81% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on November, 1. They expect $2.75 earnings per share, up 32.85 % or $0.68 from last year’s $2.07 per share. After $2.34 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 17.52 % EPS growth.
Lyons Wealth Management Llc. holds 30.83% of its portfolio in Apple Inc. for 116,337 shares. Independent Investors Inc owns 386,368 shares or 28.08% of their US portfolio. Moreover, Berkshire Hathaway Inc has 23.84% invested in the company for 251.96 million shares. The Massachusetts-based Harvard Management Co Inc has invested 22.56% in the stock. Trb Advisors Lp, a New York-based fund reported 200,000 shares.
